description: “Right person, wrong time” can be a comforting story because it keeps hope alive. But sometimes timing isn’t the problem, the relationship just wasn’t right enough to survive reality.

author: Mark Manson
description: Being single might feel scary, but being in a toxic relationship is often worse. Relationships are amplifiers: a healthy one can make your life better, but a toxic one can make everything harder. Being alone is better than being with someone who makes you miserable.
title: Being Single vs. a Bad Relationship

Kierkegaard spent the last years of his life arguing that rational commitment only gets you so far. There's a level of dedication so deep it breaks into irrationality, and the only word that does it justice is faith. We dig into his book Fear and Trembling (which is actually where the phrase "leap of faith" comes from), the concept of infinite resignation, and what separates a commitment you can explain to someone from one you can't. We talk about why the people who make it in music and entrepreneurship are never the ones sitting around asking if they'll make it. And Mark shares the moment he realized his career had stopped feeling like something he chose and started feeling like something that chose him.
